apps.localizedDescription: Build 186 enables MetalFX at your existing 2560×1080 resolution by removing the 18% runtime cutoff. Fit upscales to 2868×1210 on the 2868×1320 display; Stretch to fill upscales to 2868×1320. Keeps Build 185’s user-confirmed clean private Metal 4 rendering and compatible display handoff, triple buffering/120 FPS configuration and vibration/controller/Mobile Game/immersive controls. Simulator parity: 205 passed, one skip. Full-resolution native PQ GPU scaling/copy checks passed for Fit and Stretch. Unsigned KravaSigner build; iPhone smoothness and sustained 120 FPS with active MetalFX require a retest.
